name: dashboard-reverify-weekly
prompt: Re-run the dashboard design verification for the checked-in example contract. Regenerate the app and run `/dashboard:gates` on the workspace `*.dash.json` contract (or `python3 $DASHBOARD_PLUGIN/scripts/dashboard_launcher.py gates <contract>`), compare the verdicts to the recorded ones in the gate report, and write a short result to records/. If any gate regressed from pass to fail or unknown, say so explicitly in the run summary.
